results.title: UX Design Awards (Spring 2027)
results.eligibility_notes: New Talent category is explicitly for Bachelor's and Master's projects from all over the world, so an undergraduate Visual/Interaction Design major qualifies. No nationality bar. Fee EUR 70 per New Talent submission.
results.notes: Call for Entries 1 Sep-15 Nov 2026 for the Spring 2027 award; winners announced 3 Mar 2027. Product/Concept tracks cost EUR 320; New Talent is the student track.

results.title: iF DESIGN STUDENT AWARD 2027
results.eligibility_notes: Open to student design concepts worldwide; undergraduate Visual/Interaction Design major qualifies. Free to enter. Concept must align with one UN SDG (1-15). No nationality/visa bar stated.
results.notes: 25th edition; EUR 50,000 prize fund; awards ceremony June 2027 in New York. 7,000+ entries per year.

results.title: Games for Change Student Challenge 2026-2027
results.eligibility_notes: Open to young creators ages 8-25 internationally; an undergraduate qualifies. Free. Game-design competition on UN SDG themes.
results.notes: 2026-2027 edition sign-ups open; builds coding/design skills; aligns with the persona's game interest.

results.title: CHI PLAY 2026 Student Game Design Competition
results.eligibility_notes: Open to undergraduate through postgraduate students; a digital game is required plus proof of student status. The 2026 deadline (3 Jun 2026) has already passed; the 2027 cycle is expected to open in spring 2027, so this was listed as a recurring opportunity.
results.notes: Hybrid conference; at least one student presenter must attend if nominated. Strong fit for game-design interest but currently closed.

results.title: GGAC x Valorant "Huaxia Power" Art Contest
results.eligibility_notes: Open art/skin contest; no explicit student or nationality bar (theme is Chinese-cultural 'Huaxia power' but submission is open). An undergraduate with Blender/Adobe skills qualifies. Prizes in RMB.
results.notes: Weapon-skin and card-visual tracks; upload deadline 30 Sep 2026; gold prize RMB 38,888. Strong fit for Blender/Adobe + game interest.

results.title: SILMO Optic Design Contest
results.eligibility_notes: French optical-design student contest; a France-based persona likely qualifies, but the official contest page could not be confirmed (the deep link returned HTTP 404 on fetch). Eligibility scope is unverified.
results.notes: Discovery only; official page not reachable. The France angle is appealing but must be re-verified via the SILMO site before relying on it.
